# openwrt_sys_wireless_ifaces (Data Source)

Discovers wireless interfaces from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID.
- `interfaces` (List of Object) List of wireless interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
